Shared-Nothing Storage Engine: MemTable & Segment Flushes

panels.description: Disk write rate from in-memory MemTable flushes to disk.
panels.title: MemTable Flush Disk Write Rate (Bytes/s)

panels.description: Segment file write rate on BE local storage.
panels.title: Segment Flush Write Rate (Bytes/s)

panels.description: MemTable flush worker threads and queue length. A rising queue indicates flush backpressure.
panels.title: MemTable Flush Threadpool Workers & Queue

panels.description: Segment flush worker threads and queue length.
panels.title: Segment Flush Threadpool Workers & Queue

panels.description: Peak rowsets (versions) per tablet on BEs. Default StarRocks limit is 1000. When reached, Stream Load/SeaTunnel fails with OLAP_ERR_TOO_MANY_VERSION (-238).
panels.title: Max Tablet Versions / Rowsets per BE (Hard Limit: 1000)

panels.description: Total active rowsets stored across tablets per BE. Rapid accumulation without compaction decline signals write/compaction imbalance.
panels.title: Total Active Rowsets Generated & In-Use per BE

panels.description: Compaction throughput across Update (Primary Key), Cumulative, and Base compactions.
panels.title: Compaction Throughput by Type (Bytes/s)

panels.description: Active concurrent compaction jobs running on BEs. Cumulative compaction directly prevents tablet version explosions.
panels.title: Active Compaction Tasks (Cumulative, Base, PK)

panels.description: Running workers in compact_pool vs tasks waiting in queue. If queue count is elevated, increase compaction threads in be.conf.
panels.title: Compaction Threadpool Workers & Queue Backlog

panels.description: Per-task disk merge processing rate for cumulative and base compaction.
panels.title: Compaction Task Speed (Bytes/s)

panels.description: Active incoming streaming load streams. High concurrency with small batches causes version explosion.
panels.title: Concurrent Stream Load Streams per BE

panels.description: Flush frequency from SeaTunnel / Stream Load. If this rate is high (>20-50/s) with low throughput, SeaTunnel is micro-batching too frequently.
panels.title: Stream Load Request Rate (Batches/s)

panels.description: Average duration for BE to ingest and process each stream load batch.
panels.title: Average Stream Load Batch Duration (ms)

panels.description: Time spent waiting for MemTable flush before accepting next load batch, and commit latency.
panels.title: Delta Writer Wait Flush & Commit Latency (ms)

panels.description: Number of publish version tasks waiting in BE queue. High values delay 2PC commit and slow down ingestions.
panels.title: BE Publish Version Queue Count (Backlog)

panels.description: Active worker threads vs configured thread pool size for publish version tasks.
panels.title: BE Publish Version Workers & Threadpool Size

panels.description: Sub-second RPC publish latency on the BE engine (from bvar).
panels.title: BE Local Publish RPC Latency Percentiles (ms)

panels.description: Overall end-to-end publish latency coordinated by FE Master across all tablet replicas.
panels.title: FE Master 2PC Publish Latency Percentiles (ms)

panels.description: Total allocated disk capacity, StarRocks table data consumed, and available free storage across all BE nodes.
panels.title: Cluster Storage Capacity Overview (Total, Data Used, Avail)

panels.description: Disk space usage per BE mount path. At 95% (storage_flood_stage_usage_percent), StarRocks enters flood stage and rejects all writes.
panels.title: BE Disk Space Usage Ratio (%) (Limit: 95% Flood Stage)

panels.description: Table data size stored on each Backend node. Detects uneven hash distribution or tablet skew across the cluster.
panels.title: Data Used Capacity per BE Node (Storage Skew)

panels.description: Operational status of disk partitions. 1 = Active/Healthy, 0 = Faulty/Broken disk.
panels.title: Disk Health Status & State (1=Healthy, 0=Offline)

panels.description: Real-time CPU utilization percentage per Backend node (100% - idle%). Derived from starrocks_be_cpu mode="idle".

targets.expr: 100 - (sum(rate(starrocks_be_cpu{mode="idle", job=~"$job", instance=~"$be_instance"}[$interval])) by (instance) / sum(rate(starrocks_be_cpu{job=~"$job", instance=~"$be_instance"}[$interval])) by (instance) * 100)

panels.title: Backend CPU Utilization (%)

panels.description: Resident memory consumption per Backend process.
panels.title: Backend Process Memory Usage

panels.description: Maximum disk IO utilization percentage across Backend storage disks.
panels.title: Backend Max Disk IO Utilization (%)

panels.description: Network throughput sent and received across physical network interfaces per BE.
panels.title: Backend Network IO (Send & Receive)

panels.description: File descriptor usage compared to soft limits per BE.
panels.title: Backend File Descriptors (FDs)

panels.description: Current process thread count per Backend daemon.
panels.title: Backend Process Threads
